To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) ensemble models for time series forecasting can be used to reduce the variance on time series forecasts, and (ii), ensemble methods based on K PLS and ensemble methods based on neural networks can both be used to reduce variance on time series forecasting.
ensemble methods based on neural networks or kernel partial least squares lead to better predictions for the Indian Rupees US Dollar currency rate.

ensemble methods are superior to single neural networks and K PLS for time series forecasting, that the use of cross validation for training is a key factor for improving the performance of the models, and that the use of ensemble methods for forecasting time series allows for an assessment of confidence metrics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of ensemble methods for time time series analysis.

(i) a novel ensemble method for kernel partial least squares; (ii) the application of ensembles of neural networks to time series forecasting; (iii) the application of neural network ensembles to the prediction of exchange rates between the Indian Rupee and US dollar; (iv) an evaluation of the forecasting models with respect to their ability to predict future values of the exchange rate; (v) the assessment of the forecasting models by their ability to predict the volatility of the exchange rate, and

the following aspects of time series forecasting: (i) the use of ensemble methods for time sereis forecasting, and (ii ) the use of ensemble Kernel Partial Least Squa res methods for time series forecasting.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ensemble K PLS method outperforms the ensemble neural network methods in terms of the root mean square error, the mean absolute error, the mean relative error, and in terms of the correlation coefficient.
the ensemble K PLS method outperforms all other models for the one step ahead predictions and that the ensemble neural networks outperform all other models for long term forecasts.
the ensemble method based on the use of multiple cross validation folds for training the neural network models outperforms all other methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ensemble K PLS approach is more robust than the ensemble neural networks approach, but the ensemble neural network approach leads to more accurate predictions for the long term forecasting.
the ensemble method for neural networks is the most accurate and that the kernel partial least squares method is the most robust.

ensemble models are superior to single neural network models, that the novel ensemble method based on cross validation folds is superior to the standard ensemble method based on different initializations, and that K PLS based ensemble models are comparable to ensemble neural network models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ensemble methods for neural networks and kernel PLS are robust, but the ensemble methods for the kernel PLS are more robust.
ensemble methods are a powerful tool for improving the robustness of time series forecasting models.

the ensemble methods are superior to the standard neural network methods and the kernel PLS methods are competitive with neural networks for time Series forecasting, especially in the case of long term forecasts.
